edges.reason: Constructor assigns owner directly from the untrusted msg.sender.
onlyOwner modifier gates transferOwnership on msg.sender == owner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before transferring ownership.
sellNFT requires from == msg.sender so only the NFT owner can sell.
cancelBid requires msg.sender == recoveredSignatureSigner (bid owner).
msg.sender identity determines which burnedSignatures entries are writable.
buyerSignature is passed unchanged into ECRecovery.recover.
sigHash computed in sellNFT is the hash handed to recover.
Digest produced by getBidTypedDataHash is the message verified by recover.
recover performs the ecrecover precompile call on attacker-controlled bytes.
sellNFT invokes recover to validate the buyer's off-chain bid.
Signer returned by recover is compared against 'to' to authorize the sale.
recoveredSignatureSigner feeds require(to == recoveredSignatureSigner).
hash parameter is the digest signed by the bidder.
sig parameter is decoded for the r/s/v components.
r loaded from the signature is fed to ecrecover.
s loaded from the signature is fed to ecrecover.
v recovery byte is fed to ecrecover.
sellNFT makes an external ERC721 safeTransferFrom call before currency settlement.
safeTransferFrom can invoke onERC721Received on the buyer, re-entering sellNFT before the ERC20 settlement.
Caller-supplied nftContractAddress is the target of the external ERC721 call.
tokenId parameter is forwarded to safeTransferFrom.
sellNFT calls _transferCurrencyForSale after transferring the NFT.
currencyAmount from sellNFT flows into the settlement routine.
_transferCurrencyForSale performs an external ERC20 transferFrom to the seller after the NFT transfer.
_transferCurrencyForSale performs an external ERC20 transferFrom of the fee to the owner.
_transferCurrencyForSale computes feeAmount with mul/div and subtracts it from the amount.
_fee_pct state variable is multiplied into the sale amount for the fee calculation.
currencyAmount parameter drives the transferFrom amounts.
currencyAmount parameter is the multiplicand in the fee arithmetic.
feeAmount local result determines the split between seller and owner transfers.
Buyer address is the source of the token transferFrom.
currencyToken parameter is the callee of the seller transferFrom.
sellNFT currencyToken flows through to the seller transferFrom target.
sellNFT currencyToken flows through to the fee transferFrom target.
Seller address is the recipient of the net sale amount.
owner state variable is the recipient of the protocol fee transferFrom.
acceptOwnership reads and overwrites the owner state variable.
owner is read in the onlyOwner modifier guarding transferOwnership.
transferOwnership writes the caller-supplied address into newOwner.
_newOwner parameter is staged as the pending owner.
_newOwner parameter is stored into the newOwner state variable.
acceptOwnership checks msg.sender against the pending newOwner.
burnedSignatures is read and written in sellNFT to prevent bid replay.
burnedSignatures is checked and marked in cancelBid.
from parameter must equal msg.sender before the NFT is transferred.
to parameter must equal the recovered signer to authorize spending.
expires parameter is compared against block.number to gate bid validity.
requireProjectId flag controls whether the project id check executes.
projectId parameter is compared against the NFT contract's project id.
sellNFT calls tokenIdToProjectId on an attacker-supplied NFT contract.
nftContractAddress parameter is the callee of the project id query.
_chain_id is embedded in the EIP-712 domain hash used for the bid digest.
Domain type hash constant is used to build the domain separator.
BidPacket type hash constant is used to hash a bid packet.
Exchange constructor stores the supplied fee percentage.
Exchange constructor stores the supplied chain id.
nftContractAddress is included in the digest recomputed by cancelBid.
buyerSignature is verified inside cancelBid before burning.
sigHash local is the digest that gets burned in cancelBid.
recovered signer must equal msg.sender for the cancellation to be authorized.
cancelBid uses recover to authenticate the bid owner.
Fallback reverts, blocking ETH-funded paths into the exchange entrypoints.
